description.value: Climb Base5 is a premier indoor rock climbing facility in Coquitlam offering bouldering, auto-belay, top rope, and lead climbing for all skill levels. With a second location in North Vancouver, the gym runs structured courses from beginner belay through lead climbing technique, plus youth camps and group bookings. It bills itself as a community-focused space emphasizing inclusivity, skill development, and a culture of climbing.
